'''Frix''' was a [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Along with their successors [[Kalpana (Supreme Chancellor)/Legends|Kalpana]] and [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], Frix's [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancellery]] allowed the Galactic Republic decline under a stagnant [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] and [[Politics/Legends|political]] corruption to continue unabated. In a meeting on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] told [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who was secretly [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis, that Frix would succeed the current Chancellor, which Frix ultimately did.<ref name="DP" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Chancellor Frix was first mentioned in the article ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', which was written by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published for [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace: The Official ''Star Wars'' Fan Club]]. In his endnotes for the article, O'Keefe stated that Frix's name was a nod to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] and that he imagined the two characters to be related but that it was up to future authors to decide if they were or not.<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|valinkenobi|16|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 3: The Separatist Crisis|nobackup=1}}</ref>
